verdict.rationale: The stablecoin wallet quickstart runs on Base Sepolia with the test token USDXM, so wallet and agent-delegation flows can be exercised on a testnet without real funds. However, the docs state that Agent Checkouts testing is production-only because "there is no staging environment for it". Missing for 10: a documented general staging/sandbox environment with separate API keys, sandbox coverage for Agent Checkouts and agent cards, and independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox isolation.
